biological.citation: Wang et al. 2021 - High Expression of Annexin A9 Promotes Cell Proliferation and Migration in Gastric Cancer via the TGF-β Signaling Pathway (PMID: 34587407)
biological.summary: ANXA9 is upregulated in gastric cancer tissues and cells and predicts unfavorable prognosis. Overexpression in HGC-27 cells increased migration, colony formation and S/G2 phase entry, while knockdown in MGC-803 cells suppressed growth and migration. ANXA9 altered EMT markers and SMAD2/3 and p-SMAD2/3 distribution, implicating the TGF-β/SMAD pathway.

biological.citation: Annexin A9 promotes cell proliferation by regulating the Wnt signaling pathway in colorectal cancer (PMID: 37349657)
biological.summary: ANXA9 is elevated in CRC tissue and cells, and high expression is associated with shorter survival. Knockdown inhibited proliferation, invasion and migration and caused cell cycle arrest. Genes co-expressed with ANXA9 were enriched in Wnt signaling, ANXA9 deletion suppressed proliferation through Wnt, and Wnt activation reversed this effect.

biological.citation: Annexin A9 promotes invasion and metastasis of colorectal cancer and predicts poor prognosis (PMID: 29393380)
biological.summary: ANXA9 protein is higher in CRC tissue than in adjacent mucosa and is an independent risk factor for survival. It is associated with invasion depth and lymph node metastasis. siRNA knockdown in HCT116 cells reduced viability, migration and invasion, downregulated ADAM17 and MMP9, and upregulated TIMP-1 and E-cadherin.

biological.citation: ANXA9 facilitates S100A4 and promotes breast cancer progression through modulating STAT3 pathway (PMID: 38609357)
biological.summary: ANXA9 is highly expressed in metastatic breast cancer. It mediates S100A4 and regulates the AKT/mTOR/STAT3 and p53/Bcl-2 apoptosis pathways. ANXA9 also transfers S100A4 into the tumor microenvironment and promotes secretion of IL-6, IL-8, CCL2 and CCL5, acting through self-phosphorylation at Ser2 and Thr69. Knockdown suppressed xenograft growth and lung metastasis in vivo.

biological.citation: Exosome-derived ANXA9 functions as an oncogene in breast cancer (PMID: 37294149)
biological.summary: ANXA9 is expressed about 1.5-2-fold higher in breast cancer tissue than in normal tissue and is highest in luminal subtypes. It is secreted in tumor-derived exosomes. Silencing reduced colony formation (~30%), migration (~65%) and invasion (~68%), and halved xenograft tumor size.

biological.citation: miR-186-ANXA9 signaling inhibits tumorigenesis in breast cancer (PMID: 37841425)
biological.summary: ANXA9 is a direct target of miR-186-5p, confirmed by luciferase reporter assay, qRT-PCR and western blot, and the two are inversely correlated in breast tumors. ANXA9 knockdown phenocopied miR-186-5p overexpression, and ANXA9 re-expression rescued the apoptosis. The miR-186-5p effect involved decreased Bcl-2 and increased p53.

biological.citation: Hsa-miR-105-1 Regulates Cisplatin-Resistance in Ovarian Carcinoma Cells by Targeting ANXA9 (PMID: 33680718)
biological.summary: ANXA9 is a verified target of miR-105-1 by dual luciferase assay. ANXA9 is upregulated in cisplatin-resistant ovarian cancer cells, where miR-105-1 is downregulated. miR-105-1 mimics lowered ANXA9, raised P53, P21 and Bax, lowered E2F1 and Bcl-2, and restored cisplatin sensitivity.

biological.citation: Knockdown of sulfotransferase 2B1 suppresses cell migration, invasion and promotes apoptosis in ovarian carcinoma cells via targeting annexin A9 (PMID: 38777329)
biological.summary: SULT2B1 binds ANXA9 by co-immunoprecipitation and regulates its expression in SKOV3 ovarian cancer cells. ANXA9 deficiency mimicked SULT2B1 silencing, reducing migration and invasion and increasing apoptosis. ANXA9 overexpression reversed the effects of SULT2B1 knockdown.

biological.citation: ERα and ERβ Homodimers in the Same Cellular Context Regulate Distinct Transcriptomes and Functions (PMID: 35872983)
biological.summary: In MCF7 cells expressing ERβ only, ChIP-based work showed ERβ binds cis-regulatory chromatin of ANXA9, which is proposed as a direct, ERβ-specific migration-related target.

biological.citation: Frequent Alteration of Annexin A9 and A10 in HPV-Negative Head and Neck Squamous Cell Carcinomas (PMID: 30744186)
biological.summary: ANXA9 is downregulated in 42% of HPV-negative HNSCC tumors compared with normal epithelium. Expression is associated with oropharyngeal location and histological differentiation grade.
